from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from green.infrastructure.cad.documents import load_document
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagwriter import TagCollector
import json
for p in sorted(Path("out/real-input-survey").rglob("*.dxf")):
    doc, warnings = load_document(p)
    regions = list(doc.modelspace().query("REGION"))
    result = {
        "file": p.name,
        "version": doc.dxfversion,
        "regions": len(regions),
        "region_layers": Counter(e.dxf.layer for e in regions),
        "region_payload_lengths": Counter((len(e.sat), len(e.sab)) for e in regions),
        "region_exportable": sum(e.preprocess_export(TagCollector(dxfversion=doc.dxfversion)) for e in regions),
        "xrefs": [],
    }
    result["region_payload_lengths"] = {str(k): v for k,v in result["region_payload_lengths"].items()}
    for e in doc.modelspace().query("INSERT"):
        b = doc.blocks.get(e.dxf.name)
        if b is not None and (b.block.is_xref or b.block.is_xref_overlay):
            result["xrefs"].append({"name": e.dxf.name, "file": b.block.dxf.xref_path, "scale": [e.dxf.xscale,e.dxf.yscale,e.dxf.zscale], "rotation": e.dxf.rotation, "offset": tuple(e.dxf.insert), "base": tuple(b.block.dxf.base_point)})
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json, subprocess, time
from green.infrastructure.cad.documents import load_document
from ezdxf.acis import api as acis
source = next(Path("../").glob("Пилотны*/6. Камчатская улица/Исходные данные/Внешние ссылки/игди/XREF_ИГДИ_Камчатская улица.dwg"))
out = Path("out/acis-conversion")
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for version in ("r2000", "r2010"):
    target = out / (version + ".dxf")
    started = time.perf_counter()
    done = subprocess.run(["dwg2dxf", "-y", "--as", version, "-o", str(target), str(source)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    (out / (version + ".conversion.log")).write_text(done.stdout + done.stderr)
    result = {"version": version, "returncode": done.returncode, "bytes": target.stat().st_size if target.exists() else 0}
    try:
        doc, notes = load_document(target)
        regions = list(doc.modelspace().query("REGION"))
        result.update(regions=len(regions), with_payload=sum(bool(e.acis_data) for e in regions), notes=notes)
        if regions and regions[0].acis_data:
            bodies = acis.load_dxf(regions[0])
            result["first_body_meshes"] = [len(mesh.faces) for body in bodies for mesh in acis.mesh_from_body(body)]
    except Exception as error:
        result["load_error"] = str(error)
    result["seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from survey_cad_inputs import survey
catalog = Path("../dataset_catalog/cad_scan/results.jsonl")
root = next(Path("..").glob("Пилотны*"))
selected = {}
for line in catalog.read_text().splitlines():
    row = json.loads(line)
    name = row["file"]
    if row.get("error") or "Исходные данные" not in name or "PaxHeader" in name or not name.lower().endswith(".dwg"):
        continue
    if not 100000 <= row["size"] <= 8000000:
        continue
    street = PurePosixPath(name).parts[0]
    count = sum(row.get("kinds", {}).get(k,0) for k in ("LINE","LWPOLYLINE","HATCH","REGION","INSERT","CIRCLE"))
    if count > selected.get(street, (0, {}))[0]:
        selected[street] = (count, row)
rows=[]
target=Path("docs/research/verified-pipeline/real20_import_survey.json")
for street in sorted(selected):
    item=selected[street][1]
    try:
        result=survey(root / item["file"])
    except Exception as error:
        result={"name":Path(item["file"]).name, "read_status":"error", "error":repr(error)}
    result["street"]=street
    rows.append(result)
    target.write_text(json.dumps({"selection":"One real input per street: maximum listed primitive count among 100 KB–8 MB original DWGs; no accuracy/representativeness claim.", "rows":rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({k:result.get(k) for k in ("street","read_status","features","seconds","error")},ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
print("complete_geometry",sum(r.get("block_check")=="passed" for r in rows),"files",len(rows))

import hashlib,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
directory=Path("out/universal-portfolio-after/case-000")
data=(directory/"source.dxf").read_bytes()
overrides=json.loads((directory/"review.json").read_text())
with httpx.Client(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8765",timeout=40) as client:
    def submit(parameters):
        response=client.post("/api/v1/runs",files={"file":("source.dxf",data,"image/vnd.dxf")},data={"profile":"strict","overrides":json.dumps(parameters)})
        response.raise_for_status()
        run_id=response.json()["id"]
        deadline=time.monotonic()+45
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            run=client.get("/api/v1/runs/"+run_id).json()
            if run["state"] in ("failed","succeeded"):
                return run
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise AssertionError("run timeout: "+run_id)
    unknown=submit({})
    assert unknown["state"]=="failed",unknown
    names={a["name"] for a in unknown["artifacts"]}
    assert {"semantic-review.geojson","review-input.dxf"}<=names,names
    reviewed=submit(overrides)
    assert reviewed["state"]=="succeeded",reviewed
    urls={a["name"]:a["url"] for a in reviewed["artifacts"]}
    for name in ("verify.json","validation.json","export_validation.json"):
        result=client.get(urls[name]);result.raise_for_status()
        assert result.json()["ok"],(name,result.json())
    plan=client.get(urls["plan.json"]).json()
    assert len(plan["placements"])>=10
    review_html=client.get("/runs/"+unknown["id"]+"/review")
    result_html=client.get("/runs/"+reviewed["id"])
    assert review_html.status_code==result_html.status_code==200
    report={"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"unknown":unknown["id"],"reviewed":reviewed["id"],"placements":len(plan["placements"]),"checks":["verify","validation","export_validation"],"review_page":review_html.status_code,"result_page":result_html.status_code}
    Path("out/e27-web-demo.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

    return subprocess.check_output(["curl","--fail-with-body","--silent","--show-error",*args,"http://127.0.0.1:8765"+path])
def submit(parameters):
    response=json.loads(fetch("/api/v1/runs","-F","file=@"+str(source),"-F","profile=strict","--form-string","overrides="+json.dumps(parameters)))
    run_id=response["id"]
    deadline=time.monotonic()+45
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        run=json.loads(fetch("/api/v1/runs/"+run_id))
        if run["state"] in ("failed","succeeded"):
            return run
        time.sleep(0.25)
    raise AssertionError("run timeout: "+run_id)
unknown=submit({})
assert unknown["state"]=="failed",unknown
names={a["name"] for a in unknown["artifacts"]}
assert {"semantic-review.geojson","review-input.dxf"}<=names,names
reviewed=submit(overrides)
assert reviewed["state"]=="succeeded",reviewed
urls={a["name"]:a["url"] for a in reviewed["artifacts"]}
for name in ("verify.json","validation.json","export_validation.json"):
    result=json.loads(fetch(urls[name]))
    assert result["ok"],(name,result)
plan=json.loads(fetch(urls["plan.json"]))
assert len(plan["placements"])>=10
assert b"review-canvas" in fetch("/runs/"+unknown["id"]+"/review")
assert b"source.dxf" in fetch("/runs/"+reviewed["id"])
report={"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"unknown":unknown["id"],"reviewed":reviewed["id"],"placements":len(plan["placements"]),"checks":["verify","validation","export_validation"],"review_page":200,"result_page":200}
Path("out/e27-web-demo.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

import json, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
base="http://127.0.0.1:8765"
def call(path, *args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["curl","--fail-with-body","--silent","--show-error",*args,base+path],text=True))
started=call("/api/v1/runs","-F","file=@out/universal-portfolio-after/case-000/source.dxf","-F","profile=strict","-F","overrides=<out/universal-portfolio-after/case-000/review.json")
run_id=started["id"]
for attempt in range(120):
    run=call("/api/v1/runs/"+run_id)
    if run["status"] in ("succeeded","failed"): break
    time.sleep(.5)
assert run["status"]=="succeeded", run
artifacts={a["name"]:a["url"] for a in run["artifacts"]}
for name in ("validation.json","verify.json","export_validation.json"):
    assert call(artifacts[name])["ok"], name
plan=call(artifacts["plan.json"])
assert all("scope" in p["value"] for p in plan["placements"])
static=subprocess.check_output(["curl","--fail","--silent",base+"/static/plan.js"],text=True)
assert "Отрицательный вклад в оценку" in static
result={"run_id":run_id,"placements":len(plan["placements"]),"scope_present":True,"checks_ok":True}
Path("out/e28-web-demo.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
